title: Personal Loans Refinance-Purpose Quotes: Quote Window Near an Installment Due Date
content:
## Rule

The quote window of a refinance-purpose payoff quote on a Personal Loans loan is the number of days after the quote date that the quote's good-through date lies, each of them an interest day of the quote. It follows the loan's next due date and its AutoPay:

- when AutoPay is on and the next due date falls 2 to 10 days after the quote date (10 being the grade's payoff quote validity days, the same in every grade), the window ends the day before the next due date, when the AutoPay debit would otherwise take that installment, so the window is the days from the quote date to the next due date (a count of days between two dates being the later date minus the earlier) less one;
- when AutoPay is off and the next due date falls 1 to 10 days after the quote date, the window runs to the last day of that installment's late-fee grace period, so the window is the days from the quote date to the next due date plus the grade's late-fee grace days (15 in every grade);
- in every other case the next due date does not move the window.

## Decision table

| Loan's AutoPay | Days from the quote date to the next due date | Window |
|---|---|---|
| on | 2 to 10 | those days less one |
| on | 1, or 0 and below, or 11 and above | not moved by the due date |
| off | 1 to 10 | those days plus 15 |
| off | 0 and below, or 11 and above | not moved by the due date |

## Cases (hypothetical dates, quote on 3 June)

- AutoPay on, next due 8 June: 5 days, window 4, good through 7 June.
- AutoPay on, next due 5 June: 2 days, window 1, good through 4 June.
- AutoPay on, next due 4 June: 1 day, below 2, so the due date does not move the window.
- AutoPay off, next due 4 June: 1 day, window 16, good through 19 June.
- AutoPay off, next due 13 June: 10 days, window 25, good through 28 June.
- AutoPay off, next due 14 June: 11 days, above 10, so the due date does not move the window.
